name: self-compact
description: Lets a session compact itself as it closes one piece of work and moves to the next, then resume on its own: a tool queues the compaction, and it runs as the turn ends.

updateCheck.title: Update check
updateCheck.description: on: when a tool of this plugin is called and the last check is 30 minutes old, fetch this plugin's published plugin.json from GitHub (a plain GET of a public file) and say when a newer version is out. off: never check.

compactReminder.title: Compact reminder
compactReminder.description: Context levels at which the session is reminded, in one line added to its next turn (never a turn of its own), that a finished piece of work is the break to call compact_after_turn. A comma-separated list, each a percentage of the window (40%) or a token count (400k or 400000), such as 40%, 60%, 80%. Each level reminds once per passing, and again after compact_after_turn compacts; after a /compact or an auto-compact, only once an answered turn end has seen the window below it, so a level climbed back past within the first turn after one is not reminded that cycle. Empty: off.
